item.title: Is there any benefit to restarting your PC regularly?
item.description: Rebooting your PC regularly is old advice, but how important is this today? And how often do you really need to restart?

item.title: SpaceX's recovered Starship 40 will take months to get back to Texas
item.description: SpaceX's rocket traveled thousands of miles from Texas to the Indian Ocean for a launch test. For a number of reasons, it'll take a lot longer to return home.

item.title: What's going on with OpenAI and the Navier-Stokes controversy?
item.description: Artificial intelligence has solved a major mathematics problem, but credit for the accomplishment is murky.

item.title: 'Revolutionary' 36-year old jet engine designed for F-16 set to power world's first AI-piloted VTOL fighter jet
item.description: Shield AI’s unmanned vertical takeoff craft the X-BAT is employing axisymmetric vectoring, using a a jet engine first tested in the 1990s.

item.title: How to use the AI Clean Up tool in iOS 27 to remove unwanted objects in iPhone Photos
item.description: Clean Up has been a handy tool for removing unwanted elements from photos since iOS 18, but iOS 27 upgrades it even further.

item.title: Sony isn’t phasing out discs quite as quickly as we thought
item.description: Sony isn't backing away from its decision to kill the video game disc in January 2028. But Sony isn't shutting down production as quickly as we thought, either. Two months after reports that Sony's last discmaking plant was already being repurposed, the company's discmaking division now says that one widely reported detail was wrong. Originally, […]...

item.title: GL.iNet Beryl 7 review: This Wi-Fi 7 travel router saved my holiday connecting 5 iPads, a laptop, and a couple of phones
item.description: The GL.iNet Beryl 7 is a Wi-Fi 7 router travel router complete with VPN that runs off a USB-C port and can fit in your pocket and run off your iPhone charger.

item.title: The White House removed its border-wall Tetris clone
item.description: The game, 'Build the Wall,' filtered classic block-stacking mechanics through the Trump administration's immigration policies.

item.title: White House takes down anti-immigrant Tetris knockoff
item.description: The White House has removed its Tetris clone after a veiled threat of legal action.

item.title: Every rumored name for the foldable iPhone, as the Duo enters the chat
item.description: Apple's reportedly got a foldable phone coming out soon. What is it called? Nobody knows, but we have some ideas.
